{{Top|leg}}
[[File:NokDrayenGloveSpikes-NewGalacticOrder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Nok Drayen]] wore [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] adorned with spikes.]]
'''Glove spikes''', also known as '''spiked knuckle guards''', were small studs or spiked blades that could be attached to gloves or [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] to increase damage dealt in hand-to-hand combat. Many [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] used them as a last resort, in case they lost their main weapon. Some [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunts]] were fitted with spikes made of [[Beskar/Legends|beskar]]. [[Ubese raider armor|Ubese armor]] worn by [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] (and later [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]) had studded gloves.
[[File:Crushgaunts-Insider80.jpg|thumb|left|Pair of Mandalorian crushgaunts fitted with spikes.]]
